# 4-Week Spanish Starter Plan

A 30-minutes-a-day plan built for an English/French speaker: it leans on familiar Romance-language patterns, highlights false friends, and keeps speaking practice simple from day one.

## Weekly Learning Roadmap

| Week | Dates | Vocabulary Theme | Grammar Focus | Speaking Practice | Weekly Self-Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Days 1-7 | Greetings, numbers, days, classroom words | Pronunciation, articles, subject pronouns, present tense of **ser / estar** | Say hello, introduce yourself, count aloud, ask/answer name and origin | 10-word recall + 5 intro sentences + pronunciation check |
| 2 | Days 8-14 | Family, food, colors, common objects | Regular present tense verbs, gender/number agreement, **tener** | Order food, describe family, describe objects around you | 12-word recall + 6 short present-tense sentences |
| 3 | Days 15-21 | City, directions, time, daily routines | **Ir**, **hacer**, question words, near-future with **ir a** | Ask for directions, tell your routine, say what you will do tomorrow | Mini dialogue + 8 routine sentences + 5 questions |
| 4 | Days 22-28 | Travel, health, shopping, weather | Direct object basics, reflexive verbs, review of all core patterns | Role-play travel/shopping/health situations, speak for 1 minute | 1-minute monologue + mixed quiz + listening recap |

## Daily 30-Minute Structure

### Week 1: Getting Comfortable
- **Vocabulary theme:** greetings, numbers 1-20, alphabet, days, months, countries, classroom phrases
- **Grammar topic:** Spanish pronunciation, articles, gender, singular/plural, subject pronouns, **ser** and **estar**
- **Speaking practice:** repeat after audio, introduce yourself, spell your name, say where you are from
- **Daily split:** 10 min vocab, 10 min grammar, 10 min speaking

### Week 2: Building Simple Sentences
- **Vocabulary theme:** family, food, drinks, colors, common nouns, household items
- **Grammar topic:** regular present tense verbs, noun-adjective agreement, **tener**
- **Speaking practice:** describe people and objects, say what you have, order simple food
- **Daily split:** 10 min vocab, 10 min grammar, 10 min speaking

### Week 3: Talking About Daily Life
- **Vocabulary theme:** city places, transport, directions, time, routines, hobbies
- **Grammar topic:** **ir**, **hacer**, question words, **ir a + infinitive**
- **Speaking practice:** ask where things are, tell your schedule, say what you are going to do
- **Daily split:** 10 min vocab, 10 min grammar, 10 min speaking

### Week 4: Using Spanish in Real Situations
- **Vocabulary theme:** travel, shopping, health, weather, emergencies, polite requests
- **Grammar topic:** direct object basics, reflexive verbs, review of core present-tense patterns
- **Speaking practice:** short role-plays for travel, shopping, and basic problems
- **Daily split:** 10 min vocab, 10 min grammar, 10 min speaking

## Day-by-Day Practice Plan

### Week 1
- **Day 1:** Greetings and introductions; learn pronunciation basics; say your name and nationality
- **Day 2:** Numbers and alphabet; articles; count objects aloud
- **Day 3:** Days and months; subject pronouns; say today’s date
- **Day 4:** Classroom words; **ser**; introduce yourself in 4-5 sentences
- **Day 5:** Countries and languages; **estar**; say where you are and how you feel
- **Day 6:** Review all week’s words; mixed practice; short self-introduction
- **Day 7:** Self-test: 10-word recall, pronunciation, 5 intro sentences

### Week 2
- **Day 8:** Family words; regular **-ar** verbs; describe your family
- **Day 9:** Food and drinks; regular **-er** verbs; say what you like to eat
- **Day 10:** Colors; regular **-ir** verbs; describe objects around you
- **Day 11:** House and rooms; agreement; describe your home
- **Day 12:** Common objects; **tener**; say what you have
Media: Alt=Day 12:** Common objects; **tener**; say what you have, Learning Spanish
- **Day 13:** Review and speaking drill; combine family + objects + food
- **Day 14:** Self-test: 12-word recall, 6 present-tense sentences, short oral description

### Week 3
- **Day 15:** City places; **ir**; say where you go
- **Day 16:** Directions; question words; ask and answer location questions
- **Day 17:** Time and schedule; telling time; describe your day
- **Day 18:** Daily routines; reflexive-style routine verbs; talk about morning habits
- **Day 19:** Hobbies and free time; **hacer**; say what you do after work/study
- **Day 20:** Review and role-play; ask for directions and talk about routines
- **Day 21:** Self-test: mini dialogue, 8 routine sentences, 5 questions

### Week 4
- **Day 22:** Travel words; **ir a + infinitive**; say future plans
- **Day 23:** Shopping words; direct object basics; ask for prices and items
- **Day 24:** Health words; reflexive review; explain simple symptoms
- **Day 25:** Weather words; review of **ser/estar**; describe the day’s weather
- **Day 26:** Polite requests; combine question words and present tense
- **Day 27:** Full review and mixed speaking; 1-minute talk on your week
- **Day 28:** Self-test: mixed vocabulary, grammar review, 1-minute monologue

## Progress Tracker

### Weekly Check-In
- **Week 1 goal:** Understand and say basic introductions
- **Week 2 goal:** Build simple present-tense sentences
- **Week 3 goal:** Talk about routines, places, and plans
- **Week 4 goal:** Handle simple real-life situations

### Daily Tracker
- **Vocabulary learned:** ___ / 40 words this week
- **Grammar understood:** ___ / 3 topics
- **Speaking done:** ___ / 30 minutes
- **Self-test score:** ___ / 10
- **Confidence level:** 1 2 3 4 5

### Simple Habit Markers
- **V** = vocabulary completed
- **G** = grammar completed
- **S** = speaking practice completed
- **T** = self-test completed

Example weekly scorecard:
- Day 1: V G S
- Day 2: V G S
- Day 3: V G S
- Day 4: V G S
- Day 5: V G S
- Day 6: V G S
- Day 7: T
